text:
2. 3. 2

Desanāsuttaṃ

568. Sattime bhikkhave, bojjhaṅge desissāmi, taṃ suṇātha. Katame ca bhikkhave, sattabojjhaṅgā: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekhāsambojjhaṅgo. Ime kho bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgāti.
